correctionReason: Preserve the two explicit owner messages as separate statements rather than a reconstructed combined quotation; decision meaning and safety boundaries are unchanged.

ownerStatements.meaning: The program owner assumes all accountable company-side roles for the internal-beta decisions.
The program owner directs the team to move the bounded closure wave forward.

authority.quotationBoundary: These are two separate user statements from separate messages. They must not be concatenated or represented as one verbatim quotation.
authority.interpretation: The program owner assumes the accountable company-side roles and authorizes fail-closed repository implementation and evidence reconciliation. This does not manufacture external facts or authorize release.

governanceBoundary: The owner role assumption does not create third-party IP rights, licenses, DPAs, residency, tax or KYC facts, storage or encryption-key provisioning, historical-data disposition evidence, deployed observation, production restore authority or release authority.

decisions.decision: Results remains visible only to active OWNER and ADMIN members of the owning tenant. Every other persona and every foreign tenant remains denied.
decisions.remainingGate: Literal mounted enforcement across canonical Results routes, cold session and cross-tenant controls.

decisions.decision: Results Actual remains immutable, Finance remains proposal/dispute only, the boundary remains greater than 5 percent, and pre-decision rows must never be inferred or auto-backfilled.
decisions.remainingGate: Any environment containing pre-decision rows is quarantined from the internal beta until row-by-row disposition is recorded.

decisions.decision: Only the named in-process engines are approved. Presentation PDF must be labelled as a text summary without visual-parity claims. Unknown-provenance templates remain unavailable.
decisions.remainingGate: Engine and license provenance, honest PDF labelling and template provenance quarantine require current product proof.

decisions.decision: Only the owned internal transformation pack may ship. Draft reads must be author or platform-administrator scoped, the legacy ISO preset must be default-OFF and inaccessible, and the independence detector must be operationalized.
decisions.remainingGate: The three repository controls and mounted negative proofs are not waived by this decision.

decisions.decision: Meeting recording and transcript capture or persistence are excluded and remain OFF; authored agenda, minutes, decisions and follow-ups remain included.
decisions.reopenWhen: Legal and Privacy evidence supports recording or transcription.

decisions.decision: RPO at most 15 minutes and RTO at most 60 minutes are accepted internal-beta engineering targets only.
decisions.remainingGate: Deployed scheduler observation, durable storage, key rotation and production restore remain environment and release gates.

decisions.decision: No OAuth provider is approved for this MVP. Credentials alone never activate a provider.
decisions.reopenWhen: A named provider has approved scopes, DPA, residency, redirect ownership and revoke semantics.

decisions.decision: Authenticated deletion request and cancellation remain included; destructive anonymization or purge execution remains excluded and OFF; legal hold overrides scheduling.
decisions.reopenWhen: Legal and Privacy approve a versioned data-class action and retention matrix.

decisions.decision: Referral, certification, attribution and immutable ledger may ship. Economics, accrual, payout policy and payout execution are excluded. No currency, rate, tax or KYC fact is inferred.
decisions.completionBasis: The absent-policy default is fail-closed and automatic payout is prohibited.

decisions.decision: Commission accrual and payout are excluded from this MVP; the synthetic policy fixture remains technical control evidence only.
decisions.reopenWhen: Commercial, Finance and Legal approve versioned economics, jurisdiction, tax, KYC, reversal and dispute treatment.
